summary: Iteration 161: Tested and fixed Naukri Regex Parser improvements for CV format work experience and summary extraction. All 24 new tests passed (100%). Fixed 2 bugs: 1) CV summary extraction was incorrectly matching 'Experienced' as section header due to case-insensitive prefix match, 2) Naukri DOM format work experience was splitting on every capitalized line instead of blank lines. Both iteration 160 (34 tests) and iteration 161 (24 tests) pass.
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ CV format work experience: 'Title | Company' pattern extracts correctly with dates and descriptions
✅ Naukri DOM format work experience: 'Company\nTitle\nDate' pattern works correctly after fix
✅ CV summary extraction: paragraph text between contact info and EXPERIENCE section header now works
✅ Labeled summary extraction ('Profile Summary:') still works
✅ Industry extraction from Naukri page text section ('Industry: IT Services & Consulting')
✅ Department extraction from Naukri page text section
✅ Combined text (CV + page_text) enrichment for admin captures works with '=== NAUKRI PAGE TEXT ===' separator
✅ Admin routes to regex parser (regression verified)
✅ Multiple work experience entries with full descriptions preserved
✅ Education extraction from CV format ('EDUCATION' uppercase header)

bugs_fixed.issue: CV summary extraction incorrectly matched 'Experienced' as section header
bugs_fixed.root_cause: Section header regex used case-insensitive match on 'EXPERIENCE' which matched prefix 'Experience' in 'Experienced software architect...'
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed regex to require standalone section headers (added \s*$ for single-word headers like EXPERIENCE, SKILLS, EDUCATION)

bugs_fixed.issue: Naukri DOM format work experience was creating multiple entries for single job
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed to split on blank lines (r'\n\s*\n') which correctly separates different job entries

success_rate.backend: 100% (24/24 tests passed in iteration 161, 34/34 in iteration 160)

seed_data_creation: None - used test fixtures with sample CV and Naukri profile text
context_for_next_testing_agent: Naukri Regex Parser (naukri_regex_parser.py) fully tested with both CV format and Naukri DOM format. Key improvements verified: 1) CV format 'Title | Company' pattern with multi-line descriptions, 2) Naukri DOM format 'Company\nTitle\nDate' pattern, 3) CV summary extraction from paragraph between contact info and section headers, 4) Combined text (CV + page_text) with '=== NAUKRI PAGE TEXT ===' separator for Industry/Department extraction. Two bugs were found and fixed during testing.
